entries.title: I Chronicles 14:1
segments: ¶And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him a house.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:2
segments: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, because of his people Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:3
segments: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begot more sons and daughters.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:4
segments: And these are the names of the children which he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:5
segments: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:6
segments: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:7
segments: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:8
segments: ¶And the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, and all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard [of it], and went out against them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:9
segments: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:10
segments: And David inquired of God saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines, and wilt thou give them into my hand? And Jehovah said to him, Go up; and I will give them into thy hand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:11
segments: And they came up to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there; and David said, God has broken in upon mine enemies by my hand, as the breaking forth of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:12
segments: And they left their gods there; and David commanded, and they were burned with fire.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:13
segments: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves in the valley.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:14
segments: And David inquired again of God; and God said to him, Go not up after them; turn round them and come upon them opposite the mulberry-trees.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:15
segments: And it shall be, when thou hearest the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry-trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle; for God will have gone forth before thee to smite the army of the Philistines.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:16
segments: And David did as God commanded him; and they smote the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:17
segments: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Jehovah brought the fear of him upon all the nations.
